# Family Destinations Guide

> > Your comprehensive guide to affordable family travel, hidden gems, and budget-friendly dining across the United States.

Family Destinations Guide helps families discover affordable places to live, eat, and explore near them across US states. The site combines state-by-state travel guides with curated blog features highlighting local attractions, restaurants, playgrounds, and hidden gems.

- [California](https://familydestinationsguide.com/california): California destinations including Long Beach, parks, hiking trails

- [Georgia](https://familydestinationsguide.com/georgia): Georgia travel guide with North Georgia attractions and barbecue

- [This Historic Indiana Tavern Has Been Pouring The Coldest Beer Since 1943](https://familydestinationsguide.com/historic-indiana-tavern-beer): Knob Hill Tavern historic Indiana dining establishment since 1943

## Featured Attractions & Hidden Gems

- [The One Museum In Kentucky That Every History Lover Needs To Visit](https://familydestinationsguide.com/museum-kentucky-history-visit): Frazier Kentucky History Museum in Louisville with royal artifacts
- [The Most Breathtaking Staircase In Indiana Is Hidden Inside This Historic Mansion](https://familydestinationsguide.com/breathtaking-staircase-indiana-mansion): Lanier Mansion State Historic Site in Madison, Indiana architecture
- [This Illinois Playground Is So Massive You Won't Believe Your Eyes](https://familydestinationsguide.com/illinois-massive-playground): Bison's Bluff Nature Playground in Schaumburg, Illinois review
- [This 560-Acre Maryland State Park Will Transport You Back In Time](https://familydestinationsguide.com/timeless-heritage-park-maryland): Jefferson Patterson Park archaeological museum in Calvert County
